items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: But for that particular show, with Ethel Waters, he wrote the music, and I used to do all the extractions on them.

ctx.x: Well, he was not much of a musician, they thought, to know how to arrange things, like for the Carnegie Hall concert and the Ziegfeld Follies. But he in the Cotton Club, he wrote the Ethel Waters Show -- what's their name, oh I don't know, the time Ethel Waters opened at the Cotton Club, he put the music for the whole show.
Did he write special music for that show?
